svg.title: A letter from Mudit
svg.desc: Mudit shares his curiosity for building, his work as an AI Technical Product Manager, and the personal experiment that became LocalTV Remote. The full letter is available as plain text below the image.

text.tspan: I love building things. I'm naturally curious, and I enjoy turning
what I learn into solutions for problems I face or see others facing.
During the week, I work as an AI Technical Product Manager at an
enterprise AI company, where I help build solutions for Fortune 50
and Fortune 500 companies, along with our core AI platform.
Outside of work, you'll often find me experimenting with new
technologies, exploring ideas on GitHub, and building things simply
because I'm curious to see if they work.
One of those experiments was a small remote control app I built to
solve a problem of my own. To my surprise, it started getting traction
from people who found it useful. You can read more about it here.
I'm still learning, experimenting, and figuring things out. Some ideas
work, others don't. But I enjoy the process of building them either way.

g.text: Thanks for stopping by. I'm glad you're here.
